title: Dungeon DPS with off-heal: Condemnation engine, heals on demand
why: Damage first in farmed or geared groups: Condemnation loop, damage stigmas, heals at 8 pressed by hand. Healer build again after a wipe.

skills.why: The engine: half the damage on a KR meter, crits on Earth Punishment's target; spec +12% vs fewer targets, reset at 12.
Condemnation only hits its target, and it cuts boss Tolerance 5% for the party; spec +3 s DoT.
Held left click feeds MP for the loop; spec +20% Discharge trigger, Bolt −7 s at 12.
Free boss damage every 30 s; spec +50% attack speed for single targets, AoE only for trash.
Biggest hit, fully charged by hand inside Prayer of Amplification and stagger windows; spec +30% Skill Speed.
No-cooldown filler, last in the macro; some testers drop it on bosses. Spec +12% vs fewer targets.
The off-heal on the lowest ally, pressed by hand; spec +2 consecutive uses.
Party heal and cleanse for raid-wide hits, by hand; spec removes up to 2 debuffs.
Party HoT that runs in the macro, the healing you don't press; spec +20% healed at 50% HP or less.
+100 Crit and extra damage on every hit; the passive top Clerics raise first.
+10.5% Crit Damage, which every guaranteed Condemnation crit uses; finish with Wisdom Stones.
Contested: a global dummy tester gains with it, KR rankers barely raise it; −15% Defense spec, late in the macro.

stigmas.why: +10.5% party PvE damage and tolerance; 87% of top Clerics. Swap for Absolution when a Chanter runs Undefeated Mantra.
Level 5 first: Condemnation always crits on its target. Then toward 15 and 20 for uptime.
300 s aura that attacks your target; 79% of top Clerics. Recast after deaths and teleports.
+20% Attack for 10 s, heals included; line up charged Bolt. Summon Resurrection instead while the group still dies.

macros.name: Dungeon DPS loop
macros.key: Right Mouse Button (hold with Left Mouse)
macros.why: Hold both buttons on the boss: Earth Punishment then Chain set up Condemnation, the HoT rolls, filler last. Release to heal by hand.

steps.note: Entry 1: opens the crit window before every Condemnation
Entry 2: marks the boss; Condemnation needs it
Entry 3: the main hit, a guaranteed crit inside Earth Punishment
Entry 4: free boss damage every 30 s
Entry 5: party HoT on cooldown, the off-heal that runs itself
Entry 6: contested; delete it if the meter drops
Entry 7: no-cooldown filler, last so it never starves the rest
